items.label: Tri Chemical Laboratories press release: release 20260901-pdf (09-01-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Results briefing deck: first-half sales of JPY 14,705 millio

set.signal: Results briefing deck: first-half sales beat the JPY 13,700 million first-half plan (operating income plan JPY 2,960 million) and were a record first half for sales and profit, driven mainly by advanced-semiconductor demand in Taiwan and China; given strong demand from semiconductor makers the full-year plan was raised from the initial JPY 27,000 million in sales and JPY 6,000 million in operating income. By customer type (company estimates), first-half sales were memory JPY 8,287 million and logic JPY 5,353 million, with second-half plans of JPY 7,850 million and JPY 5,750 million; the company expects both memory and logic to exceed the initial full-year plan, and says High-k materials are running strong versus plan. Second-half outlook: demand for advanced semiconductors centred on AI remains strong; China sales will decline in the second half but are running stronger than initially assumed; domestic sales are hurt because some raw materials (for optical fiber) cannot be procured due to Chinese regulations; the second-half FX assumption was changed to JPY 155 per US$1 (initial plan JPY 150). Second-half actions include optimizing near-term production, preparing to raise mid- to long-term production capacity in view of customer trends, and building a production system for next-generation semiconductor materials at the Minami-Alps site.

items.label: Tokyo Ohka Kogyo press release: Notice Regarding Completion of Pyeongtaek Plant at Korean (09-15-2026)
items.signal_prefix: TOK completed construction of the Pyeongtaek Plant (Gyeonggi

set.signal: TOK completed construction of the Pyeongtaek Plant (Gyeonggi Province, South Korea) at its Korean subsidiary TOK Advanced Materials (TOKAM) on September 15, 2026 - the group's second production site in South Korea and its first high-purity chemical production site there, in line with its 'local production for local consumption' model for high-purity chemicals. Phase 1 is a high-purity chemical manufacturing building with cleanroom areas for cutting-edge semiconductor manufacturing, plus warehouses and ancillary facilities (total floor area approximately 6,300 m2); operations are scheduled to start in the first half of 2027. Company: under tok Medium-Term Plan 2027 it will continue to actively consider capital investments to expand its production base, looking ahead to the continued expansion of the semiconductor market; the impact is already reflected in the consolidated forecasts announced on August 6, 2026.

items.why: source ties the capex-consideration statement to tok Medium-Term Plan 2027, not to the 'local production for local consumption' model (that model describes high-purity chemical supply)
